description: Regionaal Waterprogramma 2021-2027- Europese Richtlijn Overstromingsrisico’s (ROR) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. This stock concerns the area of flood risk area. The Regional Water Programme was adopted by Provincial States on 15 December 2021, the date of entry into force is 1 January 2022. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Regional Water Programme 2021-2027- European Flood Risk Directive (ROR)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
